Attached: 1 image

🗨️ I'd like to reiterate my request, as I still lack #data to compare how many #accounts are now auto-generated or represent paid corporate/political profiles and/or #AI, versus how many are actually operated by real free people - I haven’t been able to find anything useful, largely because much of this data is collected by #socialmedia operators themselves (i.e. facebook meta as investor for #research in #germany )

If anyone happens to be working on such a #study, I' be grateful for any hint!
